show.description: In the perfume city of Kannauj, billionaire Veer Rathore returns to find the girl who once saved his life. His path crosses with Ruhi, a blind girl betrayed and sold by the people she trusted. Forced into a contract marriage, their hatred slowly turns into love, while Ruhi fights to revive her father’s legendary perfume, Ruh-e-Kannauj. In the end, Veer discovers that Ruhi was his lost love all along.
